BenefitUnlimitedComponent.bdBenefitUnlimitedDescription:
Covered Preventative X-rays 1 per 12 months
Covered Diagnostic X-ray 1 per 36 months
Other limitations apply.

Fillings (limited to 1 per tooth surface per year)
Crowns (limited to 1 per tooth per 5 years)
Bridges (limited to 1 per 5 years)
Denture repair and adjustments (limited to 1 per 36 months)
